title: alyssum grandiflorum
intro: Alyssum grandiflorum, commonly known as Sweet Alyssum, is a flowering plant in the family Boraginaceae. This plant is valued for its tiny white flowers, which emit a sweet fragrance and attract pollinators. The health benefits of Sweet Alyssum include its potential to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Sweet Alyssum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as sedation, antioxidant activity, and anti-inflammatory effects.
